item.description: New: Settings list the permissions Bolo holds and what each is for, and the first run asks for each, with Not Now on the optional ones. Fixed: Check for Updates… says when a newer version is ready, and the update window comes to the front.

New: Bolo can keep your recordings (Keep Recordings in Settings), and they follow you to a new Mac in your settings folder. New: The card shows the version. Better: The pill's bars move with your voice in any room, even when you speak quietly. Better: Each dictation shows its app's icon level with its words, and the Dictionary says Delete. Fixed: Bolo hears a quiet voice through AirPods or any microphone you choose, and Settings lists only real ones. Fixed: If Claude answers late, Bolo keeps the tidied text so you can paste it. Still to do: Bolo is not yet good in a noisy room. New: Command mode. Select words, hold Right Command and say what you want ("make it warmer"); Claude rewrites them, or writes at the cursor when nothing is selected. Command-Z undoes it. Never from a hospital app. Better: In Epic, said marks become marks, numbers become digits with short units (5 mg, 3-0 Vicryl, POD 2), and surgical names are spelled right. To try: In Mail, select a sentence, hold Right Command, say "make it warmer", then press Command-Z. To try: In Epic, dictate a short plan with a dose and a suture, saying the punctuation.
